The centaur will trample players that get too close.
The centaurs have a strong position with their trained rock dogs and well-organized troops.

The chickens! Free the chickens!

The court can be so exciting.
The creature is charging Blinding Radiance. Any foes caught looking at the source of the attack will take significant damage.
The crew is headed to Overwatch. They'll need help!
The crowd loves the variety! Keep it up!
The damaged forge will explode in: %str1%.
The danger has passed, for now.
The dark magics of this ritual have wrenched a part of your essence from you. Find this unnatural haunt and defeat it!
The defeat of the Bore Lynch generals has driven the commissar to the surface. With his defeat, the dredge rebellion can commence.
The device is programmed for three sets of curricula. Which would you like to activate?
The devourer females don't like us messing with their nests. We have to lure them away so we can get at their eggs. The females hate the sound of the lures—
The devourer tunnels through the ground.
The dredge are here. I can feel them digging under us, under Snow Leopard's sacred land. Their machines and chants give them away. Ha! It's rare for prey to come right to you.
The dredge rebels can't overthrow the regime controlling Bore Lynch until the regime's last general is defeated.
The dredge rebels can't overthrow the regime controlling Bore Lynch until the regime's remaining two generals are defeated.
The earth is my weapon.
The eastern chamber is under Inquest control.
The eastern control room is under alliance control.
The elemental hums happily. It seems to be nodding in the direction of Snowden Drifts.
The end is near.
The end?

The excess magic residue caused you to transform!

The final push to take Svanir's Dome begins!
The fire will purge your spirit from its mortal frame.
The first hit is mine!
The floor feels...quite crunchy.
The flow and freeze.

The greatsword that belonged to her sister, Belinda.
The ground has been trampled by a large group of hoofed animals.

The guards are glaring...
The gyro fuel keeps them going...

The harvest begins.
The hubris to enter my domain. To enter my home!
The hylek were restless last night. I've seen tracks and heard their croaks.
The ice shard reflects projectiles and hurts those close to it.

The krewe and I used our lab's advanced machinery to track down the MIG...which wasn't too hard to find, as it came crashing through the walls looking for Kazz. We managed to calm the MIG down, but Doxa's still fused inside. We decided to keep the MIG contained while we research a way to extract Doxa from the golem.
The lady wasn't happy with big city life, so we packed up what little we had and set out in search of something new. Our path led us here. And then it left us here.
The law is on your side.
The ley magic of Castora seems to have been pivotal to amplifying the seers' own magic. The shrine this sample was collected from sits on a particularly potent nexus.
The lid can't be moved.
The lieutenant's fallen! Retreat!
The light binds us!
The light fades.

The liquid coolant is leaking onto the command crystal.
The little oozes are trying to repair the big one. Deal with them first.
The lizard flies.
The locals call it Jormabakke. Someone in Podaga told me it's the largest camp of Svanir on this side of the Shiverpeaks—and then, dredge rushed in and captured Podaga. I left.
The lumber is extremely dry.
The magically suspended tablets contain the amassed knowledge of the Priory. Surging with power, the tablets' inscriptions emit a faint glow while they rotate around a central pillar of light.
The makeshift bow will break after repeated use.
The makeshift hammer will break after repeated use.
The makeshift shield will break after repeated use.
The meat from Bovarin Estate is the best you've ever tasted. I hate to brag...but for you, I'll make an exception. My method of curing and seasoning is perfection. You've got to try some.
The mine will detonate when the timer runs out.
The more who engage my recharge station, the stronger I become.
The more you know...
The most important things to know are how to get collections, and what can go in 'em.
The mystical liquid within the vial shimmers and shifts in a twilight mirage. Seers undoubtedly visited this restorative font to replenish depleted reserves of magic.
The next Malevolent Throw or Malevolent Strike is empowered.
The next lab I work at has to have a strict "no sylvari consultants" rule.
The next time you enter your selected attunement, your next weapon skill's cooldown is reduced.
The next time you unleash, gain access to Unleashed Ambush skills.
The northern chamber is under Inquest control.
The northern chamber is under alliance control.
The owner of this chest will return soon.
The pain's here.
The phantom leaders have dispersed, leaving their armies unorganized for a time.
The pirates of the "Ravenous" can tell you more about Kellach's plans.
The plague from these rats is highly contagious. The number and type of effects increases when more rats surround you.
The player you were trying to whisper was not found. Please ensure you have entered their name correctly.
The powder keg is about to explode! Place it and get clear before time runs out.
The power of Gaheron Baelfire is real. It reaches to the ends of Tyria. Even this place.
The power of Isgarren's wards has teleported you.
The power of the Heart of the Obscure is trying to cleanse the beacon.
The power of the gods heals you.
The power of the land.
The power radiating from the citadel of Zakiros is causing you to take damage.
The prizes!

The promise of adventure calls us north, but it takes a fierce and wild heart to survive outside of this sacred valley. When you're ready, test yourself against the untamed spirit of Hare. If you can outlast her mettle, you may have what it takes to weather the challenges of the frontier.
The quaggans are sending an envoy to the kodan.
The queen's hand in Ebonhawke.
The rabbits in this area have the perfect fur for warm winter clothing. However, they're fast, and only the venom on my arrows can slow them.
The rage?
The rats are diseased, causing you sickness.
The recon run will begin in: %str1%
The remodel, the new bells and whistles... I like what you've done here.
The rescue vessel departed with Gertrude and the luggage. It will be some time before another arrives.
The rest of me is behind that beast! It looks tough as rocks...
The riffs of an ancient song ring in your ears after your recent encounter with a Chancel of Echoes.
The rift is open, and the Kryptis can be lured out of hiding.
The ritual nectar is giving you "divine perception."
The road is long. I wish you well.
The roller beetle race will begin soon! Can I add your name to the roster of racers?
The roost contains a pungent mixture of rotting meat, berries, and insects. The many feathers near the feeder show that it's a popular destination for visiting ravens.
The same twister that knocked me around...yes. He's gone. I sent him to the Spirits before I left the foothills. He walks at my side, in spirit.
The secret of Ascension is in this pouch. Second one is half-price so you can ascend with a friend.

The security of the Pact's staging area depends on our ability to hold the surrounding territory. It's imperative that we drive Mordremoth's minions from all of the towers and fortresses that were surrendered by the bandits out in the Silverwastes.
The siege of Zakiros has failed. The malignant fog is imminent and a retreat has been called. Run!
The sight is awe-inspiring. I feel humbled, standing in its shadow.

The site of Yomm's Mercantile (est. 1235 AE). Yomm was the first merchant to set up shop in Lion's Arch. He transformed the city into the largest trading port in Tyria and served on the Ship's Council.
The situation in Nayos darkens... Eparch's atrocities only escalate. Your...gravitas is necessary.
The skritt near the Feral Dens have found some unusual artifacts.
The sky is calm. Jormag's lieutenant has been driven from Frostgorge Sound.
The small object on this pedestal thrums with a strange energy. You blink and are surprised to see your hand outstretched to grab it. A tiny, elegant placard just in front of it reads "Do not touch."
The soldier said the tavern is the only safe place. Is it true?
The soldier's resolve is strengthened by Logan's words.
The specifics of your appearance are obscured through this advanced MinTel device.
The spoils of battle!

The steam creatures are on the offensive.

The stein is full of grog.
The stein is full of rum.
The stein is full of the special.

The stein is full of whiskey.

The storm has eased up some. This is probably our best chance to find survivors.
The storms shall bend at my word!
The strange aura in this place is making you sick and impairing your ability to move.
The sun must set before it can rise.
The swamp lies dormant.
The sword has been returned, but Riannoc's spirit won't rest until Mazdak the Accursed is destroyed.
The system was already badly in need of retrofitting, but now...
The thrill of battle has increased this creature's health, outgoing damage, and healing.
The thrill of discovery!
The tomb radiates with the power of ancient kings and queens.
The torch flame repels nearby skelk and grubs.
The tower's secure, Lieutenant. Not a centaur in sight.
The tracks lead this way. I'm sure.

The trebuchets! Defend!
The turmoil of life continues, but the winds of change no longer sting. Your efforts have eased the storm.
The undead are amassing an army in the swamp! Hurry! Stop them before we are overrun!
The unit's been freed, but the spider queen still has Captain Marshall!
The unkindest cut of all.
The vault's just ahead. And with our friends and their light, we can open it.
The vegetation on this tree is loose. A skyscale dash should knock it free.
The very air here stirs at your approach.

The war against the centaurs continues, even here. We're pretty far from the main Seraph force, but we keep fighting. Cane is a one-man wrecking-crew, and the Companions know how to raise some dust too.
The warden's siphoning is interrupted.
The water in this tub is freezing cold and a little stale. It looks like an animal has been using it as a trough.
The waters rage!
The way is lit!

The western chamber is under alliance control.
The whisper continues, "Show us your strength. We will grant no leniency, but defeat us, and be greatly rewarded."
The whole of Tarir is visible from this perch. Its energy courses through the air.
The wild bears, the ferocious cats, the swooping snow hawks! Where is the true challenge of hunting? All gone, replaced by grawl!
The wind howls!
The wizard's personal vault, and I am its caretaker. Please, what can I enlighten you on? We may be at war with the Kryptis, but I'm always eager to educate a curious mind on our work here.
The wizards will be crushed under heel.
The world darkens; Dwayna is the light.
The wurm is loose. Hoelbrak needs a hero, hunters. This is your chance!
The wyvern becomes vulnerable to attack.

Then lead the fight into direct sunlight. Watch them cook inside those tin cans!
Then let's focus on that.
Then one of us gets to be a godslayer.

There doesn't appear to be anything underneath this rock anymore.
There goes another.
There goes my...promotion.

There is no sweeter smell than the incense here.

There is nothing left to take. A shame.
There is something unnatural about this... Wait, is someone there?

There!

There's a good monstrosity.
There's a nest of undead to the north. With your help, I'm sure we could clear it out and stave off future attacks.
There's a shrine to Jora just outside the haven. Her defeat of Svanir is a black eye to his followers. They hate everything she stands for.
There's fighting on the bridge! Hurry!
There's more out there. Keep up the good work, and we'll have a camp built in no time.
There's much ground for you to cover, but you can speed your travels by finding the asuran waypoints. You may have to pay a small fee to return to them faster than the raven flies!
There's no escape for you now.
There's nothing like fresh-caught yellowfin tuna. So find it for me!
There's so much life here. We need to catalogue it quickly before anything happens.
There's some kind of bug with the PM-450b models. They fritz out periodically and become aggressive. A few good whacks usually sets them straight.
There's that research poacher I told you about. Hmph.
There's the power!
There, that shaman's in the soup now. That should—wait. Reading a new fractal disturbance!

These things should come with a warranty.
They aren't so tough.

They die like flies.
They got me...
They just keep coming!
They just kept coming... Nothing but steel and hunger...

They seek to aid Peitha's renegades!
They still haven't ordered me a chair. I guess I don't mind standing.
They were handpicked by Joko himself. I trust them absolutely.
They were right to run.

They win. I die.
They'll burn.
They'll have a better chance of surviving if we free them!
They'll have to hit much harder.
They'll regret riling me up.
They're all going to get themselves killed.
They're building...something. Something massive in the heart of the mine. Not letting just anyone get too close. I only caught a glimpse of it before I was ordered back to the line.
They're coming for the tower. Hold your ground and prepare to fight.
They're in trouble now!
They're killing people!
They're lucky if a black eye is all they get.
They're not like us. They only know how to kill.
